method: Built-in image_gen, transparent output. Base plates generated separately; paired variants edited from their base plate. Each source image was resized as a whole to 1600 x 1600 and centred on a 2000 x 2000 transparent canvas.
shared_prompt: Scientific educational natural-history plate; fine ink and restrained watercolour; true transparent alpha; entire subject; at least 8 percent clear margin; no backdrop, ground shadow, text, labels, numbers, arrows, people, faces or hands.

plates.prompt_core: About twenty capped blood tubes in a two-row rack, three-quarter view, some dark red samples, muted caps, blank label strips.
Adult Anopheles in angled side resting pose, head low and abdomen raised, spotted wings, long palps, plain unbanded legs.
Healthy adult standing Tasmanian devil, three-quarter side view, black fur, white chest band, pink ears.
Blank newborn screening filter-paper card in three-quarter view, five circle outlines with some dried blood spots.
Single Photinus-type beetle, closed wings, six legs, antennae, warm yellow-green abdominal glow.
Whole natural grey koala sitting in a short eucalyptus branch fork with a few leaves.
Purple Lathyrus odoratus stem with three flowers, standard, wings and keel, tendril and one leaflet pair.
Recolour only the purple sweet pea petals to red, preserving contours, leaves, tendril and placement.
Whole side-view black Andalusian chicken, single red comb, white earlobe, slate legs.
Recolour only black chicken plumage to slate blue-grey with dark feather-edge lacing.
Recolour only black chicken plumage to whitish with scattered blue-grey flecks.
Whole standing side-view domestic shorthair cat with black and orange mottled patches, no white.
Recolour only tortoiseshell cat fur to orange with darker orange tabby stripes.
Recolour only tortoiseshell cat fur to solid black with soft highlights.

qa.views: All 14 plates on dark and cream backgrounds at 200 px; each aligned set on dark, cream and in greyscale; alpha-silhouette overlays for all three sets.
qa.result: All images are RGBA at 2000 x 2000 with alpha extrema 0 to 255 and a minimum clear margin above 8 percent. Blue and black chickens, and tortoiseshell and black cats, remain distinguishable in greyscale at 200 px. Aligned pair and sets have closely coincident silhouettes.
